verdict.rationale: Storage pricing is a fair question for a serverless platform like Workers, but the evidence never says storage auto-grows or is billed per byte written rather than by provisioned capacity. The available items cover adjacent topics: serverless SQL and KV exist (docs-4), compute-only billing (docs-15), and idle agents costing nothing (docs-32). None of these address disk or storage capacity billing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know attached disk/storage auto-grows with usage and I'm billed only for bytes actually written rather than pre-provisioned capacity
